mechanism.hypothesis: Fixed-FA family contexts may under-cover useful free-population contexts; test refresh and its sharing interaction separately.
mechanism.start: At generation start from generation2; family=(generation-2)%4; exactly one family considered per generation.
mechanism.candidate_pool: Current80 free particles whose FA differs from all four old family FA vectors; no new candidate FA search.
mechanism.ELITE: Choose the CENTER-ranked best eligible current free particle.
mechanism.RANDOM: Uniform choice from the identical eligible pool; both variants compute ranking and retain one random draw; ELITE ignores the random choice.
mechanism.rebind: Rebind all5 selected-family particles to the chosen FA with legal MA/WA, evaluate each through the paid evaluator and rebuild personal histories.
mechanism.retention: Clear only that family's old shared pool; preserve the other family pools and global result archive.
mechanism.skip: No eligible candidate means a recorded skip; budget interruption keeps a partial event and never claims all5 evaluations completed.
mechanism.disabled: No DEMAND manager, no FeedbackAudit, no CooperationEvidence, no new learner or tuning.
mechanism.observation: Only context-renewal.jsonl bounded first4+last4 events and complete counters; RunContext clock/successful-FE suppliers; engineering schema must pass before performance.
mechanism.baseline_anchor: SHARE_STATIC is the contemporaneous current mainline baseline; no historical v2 score is mixed in.
mechanism.claim_boundary: Report ELITE and RANDOM refresh x sharing interactions independently; candidate-vs-baseline improvement alone cannot establish a sharing-specific gain.
